licence.scope: Sibling Subaru/FOCAS followed: NAOJ free-use scope (owner's website terms, tier 2; no statement was found on a page serving the curves). Subaru Telescope is operated by NAOJ and its site policy https://subarutelescope.org/en/sitepolicy/ defers to this NAOJ page; credit 'NAOJ'. The statement covers works copyrighted solely by NAOJ and excludes portrait/publicity rights and merchandise; it does not name filter curves explicitly. No SVO-cited source page is listed in info.json. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
